lines: To you... yes, my love to you
Yes my love to you, you, to you
you said last night—or so it feels
When the two of us showed in the shop window
I knocked on the midnight door
That season is now before my eyes
I held on to our moments
still unforgotten, treasured all this time
"Love and passion are two different things,"
you told me last night—or so it feels
I knocked on the midnight door
and a hole opened in my heart
That season is now before my eyes
To distract myself from the loneliness
and the same melody played over and over
I knocked on the midnight door
That season is now before my eyes
I held on to our moments, hu-woah
I knocked on the midnight door
